issues.title: [EPIC] ForgePlan vNext — engineering contract and verification layer
issues.summary: Umbrella program coordinating product boundary, Protocol v1, Core, integrations, Web and documentation.

issues.title: [ARCH] Adopt canonical ForgePlan product boundary and target architecture
issues.summary: Create authoritative ADR/docs defining what ForgePlan owns, delegates and never becomes.

issues.title: [PROTOCOL] Publish ForgePlan Protocol v1 schemas and compatibility rules
issues.summary: Create versioned neutral protocol types independent of CLI, MCP and individual hosts.

issues.title: [CORE] Implement deterministic WorkContract compiler v1
issues.summary: Compile artifact graph, active decisions and policy into immutable execution contracts.

issues.title: [CORE] Add ExecutionReceipt and external reference model
issues.summary: Correlate external executions without owning their runtime state.

issues.title: [CORE] Implement EvidenceBundle and ground-truth verification gates
issues.summary: Verify actual git/test/CI evidence instead of trusting agent completion claims.

issues.title: [CORE] Introduce claim-centric Evidence scoring and R_eff v2
issues.summary: Preserve weakest-link reasoning while scoring required claims rather than arbitrary attached items.

issues.title: [CORE] Implement authority and policy engine
issues.summary: Enforce who may compile, execute, change scope, accept Evidence and activate decisions.

issues.title: [AGENT-API] Unify CLI/MCP semantics and ship role-based Agent API v2
issues.summary: Reduce tool surface, add batch context and eliminate transport asymmetries/performance gaps.

issues.title: [CONFORMANCE] Add capability manifest and host/orchestrator conformance framework
issues.summary: Make compatibility claims evidence-based and machine-generated.

issues.title: [DOCS] Rebuild product positioning, documentation IA and docs-as-code gates
issues.summary: Align site, README and docs around contract/verification positioning and eliminate drift.

issues.title: [EXTENSIONS V2] Introduce extension taxonomy, manifests and generated catalog
issues.summary: Turn the Claude-first Marketplace into explicit cross-host ForgePlan Extensions.

issues.title: [HOST ADAPTERS] Ship official Cursor, Codex and OpenCode integrations
issues.summary: Provide native host packages over the same WorkContract and policy semantics.

issues.title: [ORCHESTRATOR ADAPTERS] Integrate Kandev, Vibe Kanban, Conductor and Paperclip
issues.summary: Connect external task/workspace/runtime systems without duplicating their state.

issues.title: [WEB V2] Visualize contracts, executions, evidence, authority and PR graph delta
issues.summary: Evolve the read-only graph viewer into verification observability without becoming a task/runtime UI.

issues.title: [SERVER] Optional remote MCP and event-ingestion service for 24/7 systems
issues.summary: Add optional durable integration infrastructure without becoming an agent scheduler.
